correctness.rationale: The map T_f(x,y)=(f(x,y),f(y,x)) is an isomorphism from the magma-operation monoid to the endomorphism monoid of a finite set with an involution having n fixed and n(n-1)/2 free orbits. An equivariant factorization requires c(h)<=c(f), a(h)<=a(f), d(h)+a(h)<=d(f)+a(f); the proof allocates separate fixed-point and free-orbit image resources injectively and lifts each input orbit equivariantly, establishing sufficiency. Occurring triples obey 1<=c<=d<=n, 0<=a and d-c+a<=N, giving J(n)=n(n+1)(3n^2-5n+8)/12, and regular iff c=d by existence of an equivariant image section. Independent exhaustive multiplication for n=1 and n=2 agreed with the J-order. All 19683 involution-equivariant maps for n=3 yielded exactly twenty distinct triples; the class-count formula was cross-checked for n=1..7. No finite test substitutes for the orbit-allocation proof.
